version.changelog:
- Added free AI interpretation feature (2/day per IP), allowing users to request complete, AI-generated Lenormand readings directly.
- Updated description to highlight inclusion of free AI interpretations.
- Clarified formatting rules: card data endpoints must display API data exactly as returned; no extra analysis is permitted except using the new `/interpret` endpoint upon explicit user request.
- Removed outdated "skill-card.md" documentation.

llm.summary: The skill is not malicious, but it needs review because it can send personal questions to QiyueAstro and force unfiltered promotional or AI-generated content into responses.

dimensions.detail: Network use is expected for an API-backed skill, but free-form user questions are automatically sent to external endpoints for draws and AI interpretations, with the draw-path privacy impact not clearly called out.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown instructions only, with no executable installer, dependency install, local scripts, or privilege-changing setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation includes broad relationship and decision-guidance triggers, and the skill requires mandatory promotional CTAs plus verbatim rendering of remote Markdown from the interpretation endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, local credential access, memory writes, background workers, tool wrapping, or filesystem mutation were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main Lenormand card drawing, browsing, and optional AI-reading capabilities fit the stated purpose, but the README and early skill text understate the AI interpretation and data-processing behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with card questions, including relationship or decision details, being sent to QiyueAstro. Avoid highly sensitive personal, medical, legal, financial, or identifying information, and treat promotional links and AI-generated readings as third-party content rather than agent-verified advice.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: AI interpretation is purpose-aligned and mentioned in SKILL.md, but README language and top-level statements can leave users expecting only static card data.
[SDI-4] expected: The interpretation endpoint is a coherent feature, but the claim that endpoints involve no AI compute conflicts with the later external-AI privacy notice.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Broad activation on general relationship or decision guidance can invoke the skill when the user has not clearly requested Lenormand.
[SQP-3] expected: Defaulting unsupported languages to English is a minor product limitation tied to the API's language support, not a security concern by itself.
[T01] unexpected: The mandatory CTA and remote readMoreUrl are disclosed, but promotional tracking links are not necessary for the core card-drawing function.
[T01] expected: Displaying an external AI reading is expected for the AI-reading feature, but requiring raw Markdown to be shown as-is creates a remote output-integrity risk.
[other] expected: Passing a question to the draw API is part of contextual card drawing, but doing so automatically via a URL parameter is under-disclosed for potentially sensitive personal questions.
